in_arabic.name: علي
in_arabic.long_meaning: Exalted, noble, sublime, high-ranking, and radiant. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'alā' which means 'to be high' or 'to rise.' In Islamic tradition, Ali ibn Abi Talib is the fourth caliph and a cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He is considered one of the most respected figures in Islam and is known for his wisdom, courage, and justice.
